title: Understanding Singular Values
text: Singular values are the square roots of the eigenvalues of the matrix $X**TX$. They are always non-negative.

title: Centered Matrix
text: The matrix $X$ is centered, meaning each column has a mean of zero. This affects the singular values.

title: Rank of the Matrix
text: Consider the rank of the matrix $X$. The rank determines the number of non-zero singular values.

title: Implication of Rank on Singular Values
text: If the rank of the matrix is less than the number of columns, some singular values will be zero.
